scope: Four new native PNGs, five explicit industrial body placements, one supported valve panel; V114 gameplay and all previous raster image bytes preserved.

nativeCanvas.execution: Node/Skia, with DOM and fetch doubles; original renderer and browser fixture assertions. Only caBX provenance chunks omitted from transient decoder buffers. Source PNG pixels and bytes unchanged. This is not Chromium.

checks.name: Five exact industrial bodies use four images, including one shared exchanger
Real decoded dimensions match source manifests
Furniture uses one uniform scale within each native envelope
Furniture keeps the native center/front-ground anchors
No furniture PNG is clipped by a native room canvas
The valve panel follows its own plinth exactly once
Every measured prop contact lies inside the actual source tabletop polygon
Every contact rests on opaque pixels of the original tabletop
Supported prop pivots preserve physical x/z/elevation
Native occlusion alpha applies to plinth and attached valve panel
No scene, collider, support, actor or save state changed during rendering
Unavailable V121 furniture gives an exact baseline pixel fallback
Five admitted bodies no longer draw their native box surface
Unrelated structural boxes remain on the native renderer
All requested images finish decoding without errors
Actual V120 plinth-panel ordering defect is reproduced in the baseline

contacts.method: Left, median and right actual alpha>=128 pixels on the lower contour within the bottom 3% (at least 12 rows), mapped through real draw transforms into a reviewed tabletop polygon; tabletop pixels must also have alpha>=128. The front apron height is a separate diagnostic, not a support plane test.

nativeCanvas.visualReview: Four selected source PNGs and three complete room captures inspected. All five industrial placements are complete and remain within their canvases; the valve panel rests on the visible plinth top. Original conduit darkness outside the light cone is preserved. Small native source fringes remain discreet at room scale.

browser.reason: Chromium executable is unavailable in this local environment. No local browser success is claimed.
browser.updates: Later CI results belong to the PR and its exact commit; this pre-publication receipt is not rewritten to claim an earlier browser run.

limits: Prepared inspection rooms and one explicit occlusion pose are used; this is not a campaign journey.
The screenshots show the real full renderer at 1280x720; enlarged details copy those exact canvas pixels.
Tabletop polygons are manually reviewed against the exact pinned PNGs and describe their visible pixels, not film measurements.
Uniform fitting preserves source aspect ratios and leaves some native collision envelopes larger than the rendered silhouette.
The original semi-opaque generated alpha is preserved; this does not certify a perfect cutout.
No exact film fidelity or completed furniture interaction system is claimed.
Small edge fringes and semi-opaque solid alpha remain from native generation. No pixel cleanup, stretching or source resampling was applied.
The rendered lower front apron is distinct from the top support surface: diagnostic difference -9.29 units for the valve plinth. Three sampled contact points remain on the actual visible top plane.
The first pump image was rejected for its aspect ratio and a second native generation selected; the unselected output is documented without being added to the catalogue.
